# Emily Paige & Co.

> Residential real estate in greater Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Emily Walczak is the founder — a Realtor at Keller Williams serving buyers and sellers across the Milwaukee metro area.

## About Emily

Emily Walczak is a Milwaukee-based realtor and founder of Emily Paige & Co., a residential real estate team at Keller Williams. She holds Wisconsin real estate license #95426-94 and has been in real estate for 5 years. A graduate of the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee (UWM), Emily previously ran Silver Springs Auction House, where she developed her instinct for helping people navigate transitions involving property, memory, and value.

Emily is a third-generation entrepreneur. She lives in Bay View with her two pets and writes "mke diaries" — a Milwaukee-focused Instagram video series about the city. Her professional focus is quieting the noise of the transaction: simplifying the process, being a steady presence, and giving clients honest opinions on property, price, and offer strategy.

## Services

- Residential home purchases for buyers, including first-time buyers
- Home sales and listings for sellers
- Guidance across all life-transition moves: first purchases, growing families, downsizes, estates
- Full team support through Emily Paige & Co. at Keller Williams

Greater Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Neighborhoods and municipalities served include:

## How to work with Emily

Prospective clients start with a short questionnaire (buyer or seller) linked from the homepage. Emily reviews the questionnaire before an initial consultation call. This process ensures every conversation is grounded in the client's actual situation.

## Reputation

Emily has verified 5-star reviews on Realtor.com from buyers and from professionals in the Milwaukee real estate community, including from a real estate attorney who describes her as smart, diligent, and genuinely caring about client needs. Clients consistently note her thoroughness during showings (checking foundations, roofs, appliance ages), her responsive communication, her professional network (lenders, inspectors, insurance), and her ability to guide first-time buyers through a competitive market.

## Compliance

Emily Walczak is a licensed real estate agent in the State of Wisconsin (License #95426-94), affiliated with Keller Williams. Emily Paige & Co. operates in full compliance with Equal Housing Opportunity laws.
